---
title: Docs pipeline
description: How the template mounts a project's markdown docs, builds the sidebar, checks links and generates llms.txt.
---

The docs are one Starlight `docs` collection made of two sources:

- **Local pages** in `src/content/docs/docs/` (`.md`/`.mdx` with frontmatter), served under `/docs/`.
- **External folders** listed in `site.config.ts` → `externalDocs`: plain markdown that lives elsewhere (usually
  the framework's own `docs/` folder), served under `/docs/<route>/`. These files need no frontmatter and stay
  readable on GitHub.

Code: `src/docs/loader.ts` (collection loader), `src/docs/mount.mjs` (paths, links, sidebar),
`integrations/docs.mjs` (Starlight options), `src/docs/llms.ts`, `scripts/docs-gen.mjs`.

## Configure

```ts
// site.config.ts
repo: 'https://github.com/you/project',
repoBranch: 'main', // optional, default 'main'
externalDocs: [
  {
    dir: '../docs',              // relative to the site root
    route: 'reference',          // → /docs/reference/...
    label: 'Reference',          // sidebar group
    order: ['getting-started.md', 'api.md'], // optional: listed first, in this order
    exclude: ['plans/**'],       // optional: globs relative to dir
  },
],
```

## What happens to an external file

- **Title**: frontmatter `title`, else the first `# H1`, else the file name. The H1 used as the title is removed from
  the body, so it is not shown twice.
- **Description**: frontmatter `description`, else the first paragraph before any heading (used in meta tags and
  `llms.txt`).
- **Routes**: `README.md` (or `index.md`) is the folder's index page; `api.md` → `/docs/<route>/api/`. File names
  are lowercased (`SPEC.md` → `/spec/`).
- **Links**: relative `foo.md`, `../bar/foo.md#anchor` and `sub/` (with a README) are rewritten to site routes,
  across folders and across mounts. An anchor that points at the target's H1 is dropped (that heading is now the
  page title). Relative links to anything else (source files, folders, markdown outside every mount) go to the
  file on GitHub: `<repo>/blob/<branch>/<path>`. Links inside code are left alone; images are left to Astro.
- **Edit this page**: `<repo>/edit/<branch>/<path of the file in the git repo>`. Local pages get the same through
  Starlight's `editLink.baseUrl`, computed from where the site sits in its git repo.

## Sidebar

Generated in `integrations/docs.mjs`: local top-level pages first (`index` first, then frontmatter
`sidebar.order`, then name), then one group per `externalDocs` entry (README as "Overview", then `order`, then
file names; subfolders become collapsed groups), then one autogenerated group per local subfolder (like this
**Template** group).

## Link checking

`starlight-links-validator` runs on `astro build` and fails the build on a broken internal link or `#anchor` in any
docs page, local or external. Links to GitHub and other sites are not checked. Local pages should use site paths
(`/docs/reference/api/`), not relative links.

## Generated blocks: `npm run docs:gen` / `npm run docs:check`

Mark a block in any listed markdown file:

```md
<!-- gen:exports from=src/index.js -->
<!-- /gen -->
```

`docs-gen.config.mjs` at the site root lists the files (folders, files or globs) and the generators:
`name: async ({ args, file, relFile, root, current }) => markdownString`. `docs:gen` rewrites stale blocks in place
and is idempotent. `docs:check` changes nothing; it prints a diff and exits 1 if any block is stale, so it can run
in CI. Unknown names, unclosed or nested blocks are errors. Markers inside fenced code are ignored.

## llms.txt

`/llms.txt` lists every docs page (title, URL, description), grouped like the sidebar. `/llms-full.txt` is every
page's markdown in one file, with links made absolute.

## Gotchas

- **Restart the dev server after adding or removing a page.** The sidebar is built when the server starts. Edits
  to existing files, including external ones, reload without a restart.
- External folders must be inside the same git repo as the site for edit links and GitHub links. If a folder is
  outside it, its pages get no edit link and links to non-doc files are left as written, which then fails link
  checking.
- URLs follow GitHub's layout (`/edit/`, `/blob/`, `/tree/`).
- Only `.md` files are mounted from external folders (not `.mdx`).
- A local folder under `src/content/docs/docs/` with the same name as an external `route` is left out of the
  sidebar. Avoid the clash.
